types.label: 4 Burner Ovens
types.audience: Smaller sites, pubs and cafes where the run is tight and the covers are moderate.

types.label: 6 Burner Ovens
types.audience: The backbone of most commercial kitchens. Six burners over an oven, almost always 900 mm wide.

types.label: 8 Burner Ovens
types.audience: High-output kitchens running several services at once.

types.label: 10 Burner Ovens
types.audience: The largest gas ranges, for hotel and banqueting kitchens.

types.label: Convection Ovens - Electric
types.audience: Baking and pastry on an electric supply. Their largest oven category by some distance.

types.label: Convection Ovens - Gas
types.audience: Fan-assisted baking where the site has gas rather than the three-phase for electric.

types.label: Convection Ovens With Griddle
types.audience: A fan oven with griddle space above it, for breakfast and grill service. Gas and electric models.

types.label: Cook & Hold Ovens
types.audience: Low-temperature overnight cooking, then holding at service temperature. Electric.

types.label: Domestic Ovens
types.audience: Domestic models for light or front-of-house use.

types.label: Drop In Equipment
types.audience: Units that drop into a fabricated counter. Today that is a bain marie and a ceramic hob rather than an oven.

types.label: Dual Fuel Commercial Ovens
types.audience: A gas hob over an electric oven: gas control on top, even heat below.

types.label: Electric Ovens/Ranges
types.audience: Where there is no gas supply, or where the extraction rules it out.

types.label: Electric Ovens With Griddle
types.audience: Electric ranges with griddle space built into the top.

types.label: Gas Ovens With Griddle
types.audience: Gas ranges with a griddle plate, for grill-led menus.

types.label: Hobless Ovens
types.audience: Oven only, to sit under a separate hob or in a bakery line. Electric.

types.label: Induction Ovens
types.audience: Induction tops: fast, controllable, and far less waste heat in the kitchen.

types.label: Potato Ovens
types.audience: Jacket potato ovens for cafes, market stalls and event catering. Plug-in electric.

types.label: Rotisserie Ovens - Electric
types.audience: Chicken rotisseries on an electric supply, for counter and takeaway service.

types.label: Rotisserie Ovens - Gas
types.audience: Gas rotisseries, usually the cheaper option to run at volume.

types.label: Solid Top Ovens
types.audience: A single solid plate instead of burners: move the pan to change the heat. Gas and electric.

types.label: Tandoori Ovens
types.audience: Clay tandoors for Indian kitchens. One gas, one charcoal.

types.label: Wood Fired Ovens
types.audience: Wood-fired ovens for pizza and bread, indoor and mobile.

types.label: Charcoal Ovens & Grills
types.audience: Sealed charcoal ovens: the flavour of an open grill with the extraction of a closed oven.

finder.lead: Pick the picture of what you cook, then your supply and your covers. The types below narrow as you go.
